## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 11, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ohio resident with Internet_, Jul 26, 2026, 2/5: "experiencing issues lately... things aren't loading and responses get stuck mid sentence... worked fine until recently will change review if remedied good rp app, miles ahead of competitors like Chai, pollybuzz, ect"
            2. _Raquel Gil_, Jun 26, 2026, 2/5: "Great, they screwed up the app with the obligatory announcement and having to wait 30 seconds, I'm not saying it's bad but I can't chat well, it jumps every 7 MESSAGES, fix it. Besides, it's full of errors and glitches, when you spend a little time talking to the bot it says RANDOM words and the character barely speaks, a shame, I liked it better before, that's why the 2 stars. Besides, it is full of Bugs that take you out of the app and the language changes or does not understand you, it is very ugly 🙃"
            3. _sir lancerlot of dark souls_, Jul 26, 2026, 3/5: "Hey, I am posting this as more of a question really. the app is great, I've used plenty of chat bots and this one is pretty good. I don't care about adds, you take what you get. I am currently having an issue trying to open the app. I press on it, it gets to the loading symbol for a moment, then kicks me out. I believe my app is up to date, and I've seen nothing about servers being down. any help would be appreciated"
